plainTranslation: Energy hits your emotions directly. Feelings run hot and fast, quick to act and quick to anger. Strong instincts, short fuse. Let the body move the mood; don't fire off the text.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal point. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
